start.001.en: Free BaZi Calculator (八字) with Every Rule Cited | bazifor.me
start.001.zh: 免费八字排盘，每条规则都有出处 / bazifor.me

start.002.en: Enter a birth date, time and city: four pillars, day master, useful element and luck cycles, each citing its classical rule. True solar time for any city.
start.002.zh: 输入出生日期、时间和城市，得到四柱、日主、用神和大运，每一项都注明所依据的古法规则。任何城市都按真太阳时计算。

start.003.en: Enter a birth date and time: four pillars, day master, useful element and luck cycles, each citing its classical rule. True solar time for any birth place.
start.003.zh: 输入出生日期和时间，得到四柱、日主、用神和大运，每一项都注明所依据的古法规则。任何出生地都按真太阳时计算。

start.009.en: Deterministic readings that show every classical rule they cite. No generative AI writes them.
start.009.zh: 结果固定的解读，列出所引用的每一条古法规则。没有生成式 AI 代写。

start.016.en: ) turns a birth date and time into a chart.
start.016.zh: 排盘，就是把出生日期和时间排成一张命盘。

start.017.en: You need the date, the time, the sex and the time policy.
start.017.zh: 需要填写日期、时间、性别和时间规则。

start.018.en: You get four pillars, Day Master, useful elements, luck cycles, every line with its rule.
start.018.zh: 得到四柱、日主、用神、大运，每一行都附上规则。

start.019.en: Four pillars of a BaZi chart drawn as ink and brush columns
start.019.zh: 水墨笔触绘成的八字四柱柱列

start.022.en: Date, time and city of birth are all the engine needs. The clock time is turned into true solar time for that city automatically. Nothing here requires an account.
start.022.zh: 引擎只需要出生日期、时间和城市。钟表时间会自动换算成该城市的真太阳时。全程无需注册账号。

start.029.en: The civil date on the birth certificate.
start.029.zh: 出生证明上的公历日期。

start.031.en: Clock time; true solar time is computed for you.
start.031.zh: 填钟表时间即可，真太阳时由系统为你换算。

start.033.en: the clock time on the birth certificate is converted to true solar time for the birth city: its time zone on that date (daylight saving and past changes included), its longitude, and the equation of time. Singapore is the default.
start.033.zh: 出生证明上的钟表时间会换算成出生城市的真太阳时：依据该城市当日的时区（含夏令时和历史变更）、经度和均时差。默认城市为新加坡。

start.034.en: birth time unknown (uses 12:00, so the hour pillar is approximate)
start.034.zh: 出生时间不详（按 12:00 计，时柱只是大致推算）

start.037.en: Your chart appears here as a card, with a full reading one tap away.
start.037.zh: 你的命盘会以卡片形式出现在这里，轻点一下即可查看完整解读。

start.038.en: An empty workspace waiting for the first person
start.038.zh: 空白的个人空间，等待添加第一个人

start.039.en: Example reading for the fictional person 王大明: the four pillars as a seal, the opening line and a watercolour of garden soil in spring
start.039.zh: 虚构人物王大明的示例解读：以印章呈现的四柱、开头一句话，以及一幅春日园中泥土的水彩画

start.040.en: Example reading, fictional data. Four pillars and Day Master first, then useful elements and luck cycles.
start.040.zh: 示例解读，数据为虚构。先看四柱和日主，再看用神与大运。

start.042.en: The link is unguessable, never listed, and used for nothing else.
start.042.zh: 这个链接别人猜不到，不会公开列出，也不会用于其他任何用途。

start.043.en: Open a card for the full reading. Add up to eight.
start.043.zh: 点开卡片可查看完整解读，最多可添加八位。

start.046.en: Appears with two or more people.

start.047.en: Day-pillar compatibility, scored 0–100 with the contributing rules. Full pair remedies and family-strategy timing are part of each person's report.
start.047.zh: 日柱合婚，按 0–100 分打分，并列出计分规则。完整的两人化解建议和家庭择时策略，见每个人各自的报告。

start.049.en: Scores are engine output; higher is smoother.
start.049.zh: 分数由引擎算出，分数越高，关系越顺。
